worldcombat.skill.meteormash.summary: Charge into range and drive a meteor punch down: the foe struck head-on takes the heavy hit, other foes in the landing ring are shocked and shoved, and the ground is scorched into a small crater; the recoil may raise the user's Attack by one stage. Comet form charges farther, shakes wider and leaves a bigger crater; heavy-fist form hits harder and casts quicker.
worldcombat.skill.meteormash.use.0: Name one target at close range with a heavy punch
worldcombat.skill.meteormash.use.1: Shove the others crowding around the target
worldcombat.skill.meteormash.use.2: Leave a scorched crater marking where the punch landed
worldcombat.skill.meteormash.description: The meteor punch deals %1$s physical damage head-on and charges up to %2$s blocks.
Other foes within %2$s blocks of the landing point each take %1$s physical damage and are shoved %3$s blocks.
It has a %1$s chance to raise the user's Attack by %2$s stage(s).
The ground within %1$s blocks is scorched for %2$s, comet form is currently %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.meteormash.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.meteormash.growth.0: From level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s power and the shock to %3$s.
On: charge distance ×1.3, landing radius ×1.35, crater radius ×1.3 and shock ×1.3, but punch ×0.9 and +6 ticks cooldown — for charging into a crowd to smash and shake it at once. Off (heavy-fist form, default): a heavier punch and a quicker cast, for naming a single target.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values charge at more distant targets.
On: visible foes with a low health ratio rank higher, the best use of this finisher. Off: every target ranks the same.
world_combat.move.meteormash.text.miss: The meteor punch cracks empty ground
